relationships.name: GENERALIZES
relationships.description: A universal can generalize other universals
relationships.prompt_if_source:
I need a list of more specific categories that would fall under {node_name}. The description for {node_name} is :({node_description}).
For example, if we had "mammals", we might list specific types of mammals like "primates", "rodents", "carnivores", etc. I need a list of more specific categories that would fall under {node_name}.
relationships.prompt_if_target:
I need a list of broader categories that {node_name} would belong to. The description for {node_name} is {node_description} is ({node_description})
For example, if we had "primates", we might list broader categories like "mammals", "vertebrates", "animals", etc. I need a list of broader categories that {node_name} would belong to.

relationships.name: INSTANCE_OF
relationships.description: A particular can be an instance of a universal
relationships.prompt_if_source:
I need a list of universals that {node_name} ({node_description}) is an instance of.
For example, if we had "John's Toyota Camry", we might list categories like "Toyota Camry", "sedan", "car".
relationships.prompt_if_target:
I need a list of specific instances that belong to the category {node_name} ({node_description}).
For example, if we had "car", we might list instances like "John's Toyota Camry", "Mary's Tesla Model 3", etc.

relationships.name: HAS_DIMENSION
relationships.description: A universal or particular can have dimensions
relationships.prompt_if_source:
I need a list of measurable or observable aspects that {node_name} ({node_description}) could have.
For example, if we had "car", we might list dimensions like "speed", "weight", "color", etc.
relationships.prompt_if_target:
I need a list of things that could possess {node_name} ({node_description}) as a measurable aspect.
For example, if we had "color", we might list things like "car", "house", "shirt", etc.

relationships.name: ADMITS_VALUE
relationships.description: A dimension can admit possible state values
relationships.prompt_if_source:
I need a list of possible values or states that {node_name} ({node_description}) could have.
For example, if we had "color", we might list states like "red", "blue", "green", etc.
relationships.prompt_if_target:
I need a list of dimensions that could admit {node_name} ({node_description}) as a value.
For example, if we had "red", we might list dimensions like "color", "traffic signal", etc.

relationships.name: VALUE_ADMITTED
relationships.description: A universal or particular can limit or set its admitted state values
relationships.prompt_if_source:
I need a list of specific values that {node_name} ({node_description}) could admit under one of its dimensions.
For example, if we had "temperature", we might list states like "cold", "warm", "hot".
relationships.prompt_if_target:
I need a list of dimensions that could admit {node_name} ({node_description}) as a value.
For example, if we had "hot", we might list dimensions like "temperature", "spiceness", etc.

relationships.name: POTENTIALITY
relationships.description: A state can transition to another state through an action
relationships.prompt_if_source:
I need a list of possible transitions that {node_name} ({node_description}) could undergo.
For example, if we had "solid", we might list transitions like "melt" (to liquid), or "sublimate" (to gas).
relationships.prompt_if_target:
I need a list of states that could transition into {node_name} ({node_description}).
For example, if we had "liquid", we might list transitions like "freeze" (from solid) or "boil" (from liquid to gas).
